sources.title: GitHub - divyanshudhruv/oev
sources.snippet: A small decision model: state + typed questions (choice / noul / score) in, calibrated probabilities out. No text generation. OEV follows the System One model interface popularized by Jev and Laya: instead of generating text, it scores typed questions over a state in a single forward pass and returns calibrated probability distributions.

sources.title: Jev (AI model) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Jev is a proprietary artificial intelligence model developed by TypeSafe AI, a San Francisco-based company founded in 2024. It was released in limited early access on 15 September 2026, alongside the announcement of a US$40 million seed round led by DCVC. sources.title: Jev AI Model (TypeSafe) — Typed System One Decisions
sources.snippet: Jev is TypeSafe AI's System One model: it returns a choice, score, or yes/no probability instead of chat. The hosted API is open as of 21 September 2026. $0.042 per 1M input tokens, output free.
